title: 09 / Membrane
sub: A shaman strikes a great drum three times, each harder than the last, and then once more. Time all but stops as the beater lands: rings crawl across the hide, our universe's membrane ripples with it, and everything sinks as if under water as the hide thins to a veil on a dark sea of membranes inside the drum. She stands and watches it deepen into the dark. A seamless 22-second loop in WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
